## PDF Exports

All three PDFs were generated successfully. WeasyPrint emitted non-fatal warnings:

- **CSS property warnings** (3 per PDF): `text-rendering`, `overflow-x`, `user-select` — these are CSS properties not supported by WeasyPrint's renderer. They are ignored silently; layout is unaffected.
- **CSS media query warning**: One `@media (max-width: 600px)` rule — WeasyPrint does not process media queries for print. Ignored; print layout uses the default styles.
- **Anchor reference errors** (10, 27, and 21 respectively): Internal cross-reference links in the source Markdown that do not resolve to auto-generated pandoc heading IDs. These are non-fatal — the PDF renders correctly; only the internal link targets are dead. The source headings use author-defined anchor syntax that does not match pandoc's auto-generated `#heading-text` scheme.

No rendering failures. All PDFs are valid and complete.
